gates.reasons: C: causal chain has a load-bearing span gap — the nuisance basis B is fit on clean LIBERO features that contain zero viewpoint/lighting/background variation (fixed camera/scene in training), and after task-conditioned centering plus the purity check the surviving directions are content-stripped residue; there is no stated reason the unseen test-time perturbation displacement should lie in span(B), so the correction defaults to identity exactly on the -91pt factor it targets. The refusal of a corruption generator (its answer to the augmentation-baseline attack) is what creates this gap, and the proposal never closes it — the diagnostic can falsify it but the story is not affirmatively sound now.

Passes all six: unoccupied combination (VLA's own frozen-feature probes as perception for execution-time referent-frame retargeting + language-switched referent + referent-frame ILC) vs servoing/TAX-Pose/steering neighbors; attacks the evidenced -88pt init-state factor with a fully observable error signal (proprio component exact, probe component lab-evidenced at R^2=0.75); pure inference wrapper on any EE-chunk VLA; ~1-2M params, <1 day; pre-registered kill thresholds for every link including the ILC premise.

A: per-dimension variance-split aggregation is an incremental delta inside the crowded ACT-ensembling/VOTE/LiPo/BoN cluster — the proposal itself rates it scoopable any month. B: the evidenced bottleneck is the 23-46pt long-horizon gap, but the attacked channel (sampler seed noise) is unevidenced and implausible as the driver of a gap that size; the premise is admittedly untested, so the importance case is not affirmatively strong. F: a program committee would read a scorer-free sample-aggregation wrapper as a test-time-scaling trick, not a contribution, in this neighborhood.

A: verify-postcondition-then-retry is classical robotics practice — the candidate's own prior-art list cites OK-Robot's retry heuristics; the surviving delta (1M-param probes replacing a VLM, a hand-scripted 3-step retreat) is efficiency engineering plus analysis (taxonomy, retry arithmetic), not a new mechanism. F: in the crowded failure-detection-and-recovery neighborhood a CoRL/RA-L committee would flag insufficient mechanistic novelty — a SeqVLA-style follow-up adding physical recovery is the obvious near-term scoop and the differentiation is thin.

debates.attack_summary: The load-bearing premise — that init-state/layout collapse is a low-dimensional, systematic "right-shape, wrong-offset" bias — is unverified, and the -88pt magnitude plus closed-loop visual replanning argue the frozen expert partially adapts or degenerates outright: if it partially adapts, adding the FULL Delta every chunk double-counts and overshoots (no term estimates how much the policy already compensated); if it degenerates under OOD proprio, additive retargeting cannot repair garbage trajectories. Secondarily, the mechanism is a bundle of benchmark-specific heuristics (templated-grammar parsing, hand-tuned alpha-ramp, gripper-event switching, sim-privileged probe labels) that a reviewer reduces to "visual servoing 1996 with a learned pose head bolted beside — not inside — the VLA," and the ILC third dimension is likely inert since same-type subtasks rarely repeat within one LIBERO-Long episode.
debates.verdict_reasoning: The critic's strongest attack (premise falsity / overshoot) is precisely what R2's pre-registered diagnostics adjudicate for near-zero cost — a $0 replay analysis on existing failure logs plus <1 GPU-day of corrected rollouts with explicit kill thresholds (<10pt gain, <1cm probe error, no-harm gate) — so killing now pre-empts a decisive cheap test rather than saving a GPU-month; and the causal story (EE-delta chunks executed from a shifted start miss by the start offset) is mechanistically concrete and supported by the lab's own R^2=0.75 probe evidence on a verified -88pt bottleneck. The novelty margin is thin but the claimed combination (probes on the VLA's own frozen features, language-selected referent switching, referent-frame ILC, zero retraining) is absent from every named neighbor, the ILC component has its own pre-registered drop condition so the core survives without it, and frozen-backbone compliance is by construction. Critic wounds but does not clearly dominate: R2 survives to its diagnostic gate.

debates.attack_summary: The correction signal Delta = (probe pose − demo-prior pose) is not the policy's error: SmolVLA is a closed-loop policy trained under LIBERO's own per-episode object-pose randomization, so the "demo-prior referent pose cached once" is a distribution, not a point — in nominal conditions Delta is large and nonzero for a policy that is already handling that variation, and the wrapper actively fights it (the below-probe-noise identity gate cannot save this, since in-distribution pose spread far exceeds probe noise). Under shift the policy partially perceives the true pose (the cited R²=0.75 probe is the proposal's own evidence), so adding the full offset double-counts whatever the expert already corrected, and the mechanism has no estimator for how much the policy accounted for — the same unobservable-error flaw that killed C19, now hidden inside geometry. Worse, on the headline −88pt robot-init-state factor the objects don't move, so the referent term is identically zero and the mechanism degenerates to an EE-start-offset ramp whose stated 0→1 schedule displaces the grasp endpoint away from the unmoved object. Novelty then reduces to trajectory transfer via pose registration (Schulman et al. 2013) / DINOBot-DOME-style servo-to-demo-frame retrofits, with "language-selected referent" being a regex over a closed template grammar and the "VLA's-own-features" probe an implementation detail the authors themselves concede is swappable for an off-the-shelf pose estimator.
debates.verdict_reasoning: The mechanism is internally incoherent on the exact factor it is scoped to fix (init-state: zero referent Delta, wrong-signed start-offset ramp) and ill-posed everywhere else (double-counting against a partially-perceiving closed-loop expert), so even a passing 20-rollout diagnostic would reflect slice-tuned ramp constants, not the claimed causal story. The evaluation is additionally unfair as designed: probes consume privileged MuJoCo state supervision the baseline never sees, and the mandatory cheap comparator — a tiny learned residual head trained on the same labels, which subsumes the hand-derived geometry — is absent from the plan. With the premise (policy regresses to demo-absolute geometry) unvalidated and the novelty delta reducible to a servoing/trajectory-transfer retrofit, this does not merit a GPU-month.

debates.attack_summary: R2's three claimed dimensions collapse under inspection to roughly one: "data efficiency" is the identical geometric-bias-correction path re-plotted against demo count (the exact one-measurement-counted-three-times attack R1 answered and R2 did not), and the ILC third dimension is structurally inert on LIBERO-Long — episodes contain only 1-2 same-type subtask repetitions, so a per-episode buffer cannot converge while a cross-episode buffer contaminates the eval protocol by adapting on test episodes, and the proposal itself pre-authorizes dropping it ("else drop the ILC component"). Worse, the novelty delta and the transfer story are mutually exclusive: the only stated separation from 1996 visual servoing is "probes on the VLA's own frozen features," but those probes are supervised by MuJoCo sim-state labels of the same benchmark, and the admitted real-robot path (swap in an off-the-shelf pose estimator) surrenders precisely that delta, reducing the paper to a pose-estimator servoing residual bolted onto a policy. Best case is therefore a benchmark-specific fix for 2 of ~7 LIBERO-Plus factors built on LIBERO-only scaffolding (templated instruction grammar, per-task demo-prior pose lookup that isn't even a well-defined point under nominal randomization).
debates.verdict_reasoning: Even granting correctness, the mechanism is an alpha-ramped P-controller toward a probe-read goal pose — its most interesting kernel ("frozen features decode geometry the policy fails to act on") is an analysis observation partially occupied by existing VLA probing work, and the obvious fair baselines (re-anchoring EE-delta chunks to actual proprio start, which the model already receives; finetuning only the ~100M action expert on init-randomized demos, which frozen-BACKBONE rules permit) plausibly eat most of the headline gain, leaving an eval-artifact story rather than a mechanism. One real dimension on two sim factors with sim-supervised probes is a workshop paper or RA-L short, not the >=3-dimension Q1 contribution the batch requires; with R1 covering appearance factors more broadly and R4 carrying a publishable taxonomy deliverable, R2 is the borderline-significance submission this gate exists to kill.
